body.x: The World's largest consumer electronics trade show 'CES 2014' opened its door today(7 Jan, EST) that will continue till 10th.

'CES (The International Consumer Electronics Show) 2014' owned and produced by CEA , is filled with more than 3,200 companies from 150 countries, attracting 152,000 attendees. The show offers the opportunities for the attendee to watch the trend in world appliances and cutting edge electronic technologies.

At the 'TechZone', main technologies of the year will be showcased including 3D Printing, Driverless Cars, Health Technology, Sensor Technology, HD TV(Utra HD TV), and Wearable Technology. What CES has announced as keywords are Startup Technology, Motion tech zone, Meeting tech authors, Keynote addressed by tech titans and innovators, IOC(Internet of Everything), CES Innovations Awards.
Particularly, the show features Tech Titans Keynote series along with Technology Innovators Keynote series, that include CEA Gary Shapiro, Sony Kazuo Hirai, Yahoo! Marissa Mayer, Cisco John Chambers.
